text:
maria-cs: Heads up — Aster Labs (Sam) is ramping across two new teams (Search + Support). Last 48h: QPS ~18 -> ~60 (3.3x), embedding requests +2.5x. They asked about reserving capacity and predictable tail latencies.
ben-ae: Good signal — renewal in ~6 weeks. Could be expansion. Can we get a recommended committed capacity and a ballpark cost delta?
li-eng: We can provision a small Dedicated pool (start 1 GPU) and autoscale up to 2 GPUs for bursts. Tail latency depends on model choice — what models are they running?
sam-aster: We're on redwood/gpt-medium-compat for chat and redwood/embed-v1 for embeddings. Also using longer contexts for summaries.
maria-cs: Added model details. They want a 60m enablement workshop for their engs next Wed and 2 office hours afterward.
tom-support: I can prepare a short runbook + sample rate-limit configs. Do they have a validation dataset we can use for perf tests?
maria-cs: Sam will share a synthetic corpus for soak testing.
sam-aster: Uploaded a 2GB synthetic corpus to the S3 link: https://s3.aws/aster/synth-v1 (redacted).
nora-opsbot: Alert: spike detected for aster-labs-prod — avg_latency 220ms for embeddings during 14:20-14:50 UTC, error_rate 1.2% (rate-limit events logged).
li-eng: 220ms exceeds their requested 200ms tail. Quick fixes: enable prefix/KV caching for their typical prompts and switch embeddings to the quantized execution path. I'll open an infra config PR (infra/aster/dedicated.json) with autoscale policy and cache rules.
ben-ae: Pricing note: reserved 1 GPU + burst to 2 GPUs ~ $6k/mo delta. Recommend offering a 10% credit on the first quarter to help close expansion. Thoughts?
maria-cs: :thumbsup: I'll propose that. Also need to coordinate workshop content — @li-eng can you present tuning + caching?
li-eng: Yep — will put together a 15-slide deck and example scripts covering batching, cache hints, and quantization recommendations.
tom-support: Draft runbook will include a troubleshooting checklist and these sample overrides:
```json
{"rate_limit":3000, "window_sec":60, "burst_capacity":1.5}
```
maria-cs: Next steps: Ben to send pricing + proposal, Li to open infra PR and join the workshop, Tom to draft runbook, Sam to confirm S3 access and pick workshop time. Ping me if blocked.
ben-ae: I'll draft the proposal and pricing email by EOD tomorrow.
sam-aster: Confirm workshop Wed 10am PT works for our engs.
maria-cs: Thanks all — adding to renewal tracker and flagging as high-opportunity expansion. cc @eng-team
